messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Excellent! That's a huge improvement - you now have excellent signal strength and 5G network. Since you're in France (outside your home network), you also need to make sure data roaming is turned ON in your phone settings.

**Step 5: Enable Data Roaming on Your Phone**

Even though I've enabled roaming on your line from our side, your phone also needs to have data roaming turned ON to use mobile data while abroad.

Please use the following action on your phone:
- **toggle_roaming** (This will turn data roaming ON)

After you do this, let me know what you see in your status bar. Then we'll run a speed test to confirm your internet speed.

Please go ahead and turn on data roaming now.

I tried to turn on data roaming, but it says that data roaming is now OFF. The status bar still shows excellent signal strength, 5G, and data enabled. What should I do to turn data roaming ON?

Please review the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
